clips.title: The story
paras: In Durotar's Valley of Trials, young shaman face demonic felstalkers as a test of readiness. Their hooves are brought to Canaga Earthcaller before they learn to commune with the earth spirits.

Canaga Earthcaller sends young shaman against the demonic taint threatening Durotar. The Burning Blade Coven lies north in the Valley of Trials, where felstalkers roam among the coven's vile familiars. Taking a felstalker's hoof tests a shaman's endurance, resolve, and spirit. Those who subdue the beasts prove ready to receive the secrets of the earth and prepare the ceremonial sapta for communing with elemental spirits.
